decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records J_SENSOR_SIG as the main-to-sensor signal connector reference; no additional state change is required.
The candidate already identifies J_SENSOR_PWR, its connector type, pin count, pinout, and main-to-sensor topology; the source restates these facts without changing them.
The source identifies the two connections entering the sensor board and does not change the SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
J_LED_CHG and the charge-status circuit are unrelated to the two main-to-sensor-board connectors identified by the source.
The source concerns connections from the main board to the sensor board, not the separate panel power-button connector on the main board.
The limitation applies to sensor-board inputs and does not alter the panel-mounted reset interface connected to the main board.
The panel GPIO controls remain separate main-board interfaces and are not described as sensor-board connections.
The source specifies the interboard links to the sensor board and does not remove or modify the independently provided PIR connector.
The capacitive-touch connectors are independent main-board inputs and are unaffected by the sensor-board interconnection statement.
The source does not discuss the buzzer, its selected part, mounting, voltage support, or production policy.
The source does not change the addressable LED power supply, data drive, level shifting, or power-control behavior.
The LED array board is separate from the sensor board, and none of its count or component attributes are changed by the source.
